ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (localized in mid-lobe regions) to low-intensity black pixels (concentrated in the central region and perimeter).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black pigmentation forms a central bifurcated 'V' shape extending from the peduncle to the median notch. The lateral fields are dominated by contiguous white pixel blocks. Black mottling and high-frequency pixel stippling are present along the transition zones between the white interiors and the black trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits a continuous series of low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys of 2-5 pixels). A significant macro-level irregular indentation is detected at the distal margin of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The distal edges of both lobes follow a convex curve transitioning into a near-linear, slightly concave trajectory as the boundary approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, circular low-intensity pixel clusters (diameters 5-10 pixels) are visible within the white fields, particularly on the left lobe, consistent with barnacle scar footprints.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible within the black central pigmentation on the right side of the notch, appearing as parallel low-intensity tracks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular truncation and jagged edge profile is present at the far distal tip of the left lobe, indicating non-uniform tissue loss compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric black pigmentation 'islands' are visible within the white field of the right lobe near the trailing edge boundary.
